clips.title: The story
paras: A cryptic musty scroll provides the final set of verse left behind by Cortello. The rhyming instructions direct treasure hunters far north to the troubled continent of Lordaeron, where the trail reaches its conclusion along the coastal waterfalls of the Hinterlands.

Following the earlier scrolls, this weathered text points away from the southern tropics toward the embattled lands of Lordaeron. The riddle bids searchers to seek out the great turmoil in the north, promising that the long chase ends by braving that unrest and pursuing the coastline.
The verse specifies that the final hoard lies along the shore of the Hinterlands. At the base of the great falls, the treasure lies underwater.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To Lordaeron! The great land of turmoil
Where brave soldiers with death do toil
Find your way through the great unrest
There you will find the end to this quest
Along the coast of the Hinterlands, at the base of the great falls
Underneath the water there does your treasure call!
